manifest_replacement.subject: 明代江南单层商铺（原创扩展）
manifest_replacement.prompt: Use case sketch-to-render. The attached box is a LOCKED geometric guide: keep camera and base outline pixel-accurate. Transform it into a single-storey Ming Jiangnan shop, front facade faces lower-left, white plaster side gable faces lower-right, charcoal grey tiled gable roof on top. Three dark brown timber storefront bays with open shelves, central counter, bolts of cloth and ceramic jars, simple small plain cloth awning. No letters or signs. Realistic restrained matte detailed historical game asset, believable small clay tiles, timber grain and stone joints, not cartoon. Ground footprint7 metres front width by5 metres depth: ground edge from left to near corner is40% longer than right-to-near corner. All base edges rise ONE pixel for every TWO horizontal pixels, strictly 2:1 dimetric. Square guide base vertices L(132,628), F(575,850), R(892,692). Keep those exact relative positions, vertical posts vertical, parallel opposite sides, no perspective. Narrow grey stone ground edge complete and thin, no thick plinth. Upper-left daylight, shadow tiny to lower-right. Opaque subject and true transparent RGBA alpha0 outside, no glow or haze. Entire complete building with margins. Remove all grey guide fill and outlines. No people, writing, labels, modern objects or scenery. ONE shop.
